newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - June 18.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - June 18.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Wednesday:
* The Dow Jones industrial average fell 11.31 points to 7,760.78 on Tuesday as investors took profits after last week's record-setting rally.
* Indonesia's senior cabinet minister said on Tuesday the government would continue reforms to liberalise the economy.

* On Tuesday, the Jakarta composite index fell 0.20 points, or 0.03 percent, to close at 705.08 points after touching a day's high of 707.85 points due to late profit-taking as generally soft regional markets dampened market sentiment, brokers said.
* On Wednesday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,427.25/27.75 at 0140 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,427.00/28.00.

* Textile firm Roda Vivatex on market talk of a possible take-over and that the firm was likely to announce a rights issue. The firm has denied the rumours. Roda has made modest gains in active trading in the past several days due to the rumours.

* Toll road operator Citra Marga on one-for-one rights issue announcement and an upward revision in its 1997 net profit forecast to 154 billion rupiah from the previous forecast of 145 billion rupiah.
* Bakrie Finance Corporation on reports it planned to increase its stake in small-sized bank PT Bank Nusa Internasional to 82 percent from 47 percent.

* Bank BDNI on a report that its first quarter net profit was 69.1 billion rupiah, compared with 39.2 billion rupiah in the same 1996 period. The bank expected to book net profit of 350 billion rupiah for 1997, compared with 190 billion rupiah in 1996.

* Pulp and paper maker Indah Kiat Pulp and Paper IKPP.JK on a report in Bisnis Indonesia that it will change its plan to use the proceeds of a proposed rights issue. Previously it said the proceeds would be used to establish a 10th pulp mill. The paper did not provide details.
